name: Pact Wizard (CR 7) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Pact Wizard (CR 7) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Pact Wizard (CR 12)" but are not part of the Pact Wizard (CR 7) entry, which is unchanged.

Defensive Abilities energy absorption 36/day, protective ward 8/day (5 rounds, +3), resistance; Resist fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 dispelling burst dagger +7/+2 (1d4+1, 19-20)
Ranged +1 dispelling burst dagger +9/+4 (1d4+1, 19-20)
Wizard Spells Prepared (CL 12th, concentration +17)

6th Level–greater dispel magic, guards and wards (DC 22), legend lore
5th Level–break enchantment, commune with text, cone of cold (DC 20), dismissal (DC 21), hold monster (DC 20)

Skills Diplomacy +14, Knowledge (arcana) +20, Knowledge (planes) +20, Knowledge (religion) +36, Linguistics +20, Profession (scribe) +18, Spellcraft +20/+22, Use Magic Device +14
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Sylvan
SQ arcane bond (cat familiar), effortless magic, great power, greater expense (Voicests27), opposition schools (Illusion, Necromancy), patron spells (Mind)
Gear amulet of natural armor +3 (18,000 gp), belt of physical might +2 (Dex, Con) (10,000 gp), chronicler’s kit (40 gp), +1 dispelling burst dagger (18,302 gp), headband of mental superiority +2 (16,000 gp), patternward spectacles (750 gp), 2 potions of cure serious wounds (1,500 gp), ring of protection +2 (8,000 gp), staff of journeys (27,200 gp), tome of stone wards (8,385 gp), tome of epics (50 gp), wizard’s kit (21 gp)
